name: Grupo Dental Clinics
note: Founded in Málaga by three friends, one of them CEO Iván Fernández: 'hace 12 años' in December 2023 (about 2011), and 'Desde 2010' in the club's 2025 renewal. 17 clinics across the provinces of Málaga, Granada, Almería, Jaén and Cádiz (club announcement, 2023-12-18). No register naming its shareholders was opened, so parentId is null.
